name: How long does it take to install cove molding in a standard room?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install cove molding in a standard room?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installing cove molding in a standard-sized room typically takes one to two days, depending on the room's complexity and the installer's experience. Factors like ceiling height, the number of corners, and whether the walls are perfectly straight can influence the timeline. Older homes, common in areas like Central Bench or West Boise, might have less consistent wall angles, which can add to the installation time. Our team in Garden City, Meridian, Eagle, Kuna, and Star plans for these variables to provide an accurate project schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation of cove molding in a standard room usually takes 1-2 days, though room complexity and wall consistency can affect the timeline.
